title: agent-workbench review
description: Contents of .workbench/reviews/<phase>-<n>.json. `phase` and `n` are optional self-describing copies of the file name; when present the Python validator checks that they match the file name. Semantic rule enforced by the Python validator (not expressible here): verdict `pass` requires counter_evidence_count >= 1 and no finding with severity `high` and resolved false.
